DOMAIN_VIOLATION_ASIN: Can't take the inverse sine of n < -1, n > 1
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_LOGARITHM_OF_NEGATIVE: Can't take the logarithm of a negative number
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_LOGARITHM_OF_ZERO: Can't take the logarithm of zero
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_NEGATIVE_BASE_FACTORIAL: Can't take the factorial of a negative number
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_NON_INTEGER_BASE_FACTOR: Can't take the factorial of a non-integer
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_NTH_ROOT: Can't take the nth root of a number
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_TAN_DEGREES: Can't take the tangent of 90 + 180k, k ∈ ℤ
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_TAN_GRADIANS: Can't take the tangent of 100 + 200k, k ∈ ℤ
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_TAN_RADIANS: Can't take the tangent of π/2 + πk, k ∈ ℤ
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_ZERO_BASE_NEGATIVE_ORDE: Can't take 0 to the power of a negative number
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_ZERO_BASE_NON_INTEGER_O: Can't take a negative number to the power of a non-integer number
DOMAIN_VIOLATION_ZERO_BASE_ZERO_ORDER: Can't take 0 to the power of 0
